overview: ASSAUD membership is open to all Actuarial science students at the University of Dar es Salaam. Membership gives you access to study materials, events, mentorship, and a supportive community.

benefits.title: Study Materials
benefits.description: Full access to our library of lecture slides, tutorials, past papers, and quizzes.

benefits.title: Career Support
benefits.description: Mentorship from industry professionals, internship opportunities, and career guidance.

benefits.title: Networking Events
benefits.description: Priority access to career fairs, workshops, and networking events.

benefits.title: Community
benefits.description: Join a supportive community of actuarial science students across all year levels.

benefits.title: Industry Connections
benefits.description: Direct access to our partner organizations for internships and job opportunities.

benefits.title: Recognition
benefits.description: Eligibility for ASAUD awards, scholarships, and recognition programs.

categories.name: Full Members
categories.description: For students currently enrolled in the Actuarial Science programme at UDSM.
eligibility: Currently registered in Actuarial Science programme

categories.name: Associate Members
categories.description: For students from related fields (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics).

categories.name: Alumni Members
categories.description: For graduates of the Actuarial Science programme at UDSM.

joinSteps.title: Fill Registration Form
joinSteps.description: Complete the online membership registration form with your details.

joinSteps.title: Verify Your Student Status
joinSteps.description: Provide your UDSM student ID number for verification.

joinSteps.title: Wait for Approval
joinSteps.description: Your application will be reviewed and approved within 2-3 business days.

joinSteps.title: Access Member Resources
joinSteps.description: Receive your welcome email and start accessing all member benefits.
